title: Address book hangs when I click on any entry in it
creator: gf1701
content: On my Windows 11 PC, when I open my Thunderbird Address Book and click on any entry, or right-click and select any option, a solid grey veneer overlays the Address Book window, and nothing else happens: The feature hangs. I can close the window and continue to use Thunderbird, but all I can do in the Address Book is scroll through the names and email addresses. When this first happened, I updated Thunderbird to release 159.0 (64-bit), but the same thing happens in that version. I've done web and forum searches and have not seen any other reports of this. Any ideas as to why this is happening to me, or how I might fix it? (I've attached a redacted screen image showing what I see.)
